notes.title: Patch 1 is LIVE #15
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/4927eb6d10e0b07e94a03cbce63e2b9c8344025a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]📢 Patch 1 is LIVE![/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]\[General Updates][/h2][list][*][p]⚠️ [b]Save File Version Updated[/b][/p][p]Older save files are no longer compatible. However, you can start any Level directly from the "Chapters" menu - everything is unlocked during Early Access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Japanese Localization Improvements[/b]
Correct font applied and all text cropping issues resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cutscene Stability Fix[/b]
Cutscenes will no longer pause when unplugging a gamepad or opening the Steam Overlay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Enhancements[/b]
Steam Deck-specific hint graphics now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Boost[/b]
Enabled Incremental Garbage Collection for a slight performance improvement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Bug Fixes[/b]
Various bugs in dialogues have been addressed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mining Farm Interaction[/b]
Interacting with a mining farm now reliably destroys it—no more missed kicks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pizza Adjustment[/b]
Pizza limit is now set to 12. Purchases from the Supershop now give 4 pizzas instead of just 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Noclip[/b]
Noclip movement can now be used with a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Driving Animation Fix[/b]
John’s hands no longer shift awkwardly while driving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicle Exit Bug[/b]
Cars no longer launch upward when exiting while in motion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Double-Barrel Shotgun[/b]
If one shell remains, it can now still be fired.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toilet Interaction Fix[/b]
Using the toilet should now work as expected (previously, it could end instantly).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement Fixes[/b]
Killing 500 Crocos now correctly awards the related achievement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FoV Limit Increased[/b]
Maximum Field of View (FoV) raised to 130.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Widescreen Fixes[/b]
Improved Boss Bar display and menu fade-outs for ultrawide monitors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosion Optimization[/b]
Enemy body explosions now use optimized effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arcade Localization Fixes[/b]
Text and UI improvements for Asian languages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Checkpoints Added[/b]
Most levels now start with checkpoints for improved flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supershop Navigation[/b]
Gamepad navigation in the Supershop is now smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu Navigation[/b]
Keyboard and gamepad navigation have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hard Mode Unlock Changes[/b] ⚠️ Hard difficulty is now unlocked after completing the game on any other difficulty. If you've already defeated Crazy Bibix, it will unlock immediately. This change was made after feedback that enemies felt too tanky when starting on Hard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stability Improvements[/b]
The game now remains stable even if you stay on a Level for over 2 hours.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]\[Level-Specific Fixes][/h2][p][b]Level 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dog's kick now uses the correct animation model.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged basement objects to prevent wall clipping.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected player spawn point.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced starting burgers with chickens.[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting and lightmap fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed world disappearing near destroyed soda vending machine.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 5[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed potential softlock in Dopefish Easter Egg corner.[/p][/*][*][p]Added checkpoints: after sewers, rooftop jump, and level start.[/p][/*][*][p]Vanomas' house audio volume increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved FPS drops near Vanomas’ house (mirror zone fixed).[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting fix near ATMs.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 6[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lighting improvements throughout.[/p][/*][*][p]Grates added to closed doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed physics on potted grass.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected grate textures during armored car segment.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 7 (Boss: Fatty)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Boss can no longer jump (because people really don't understand this mechanic. I'm dead serious.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight health balance adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Player now gets the correct weapon loadout before the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 9[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected cactus models in final cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stretched flags in Master-Croco's wagon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimization improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting in: roach house, military vehicles, bar toilets, and graveyard.[/p][/*][*][p]Destroyed desert watchtower debris no longer vanishes instantly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Secret Level[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added grates to closed doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mission objective text.[/p][hr][/hr][/*][/list][h3][b]📢 Content Update #1 is currently schedulled on September 12.[/b][/h3][p]Thanks for your attention! We will continue to read feedback, and continue improving the game![/p][p][/p][h1]ROADMAP UPDATED:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/fe149aa488c1bf0fd820d4416d21e41c28f4c22f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BRUTAL JOHN 2 Early Access OUT NOW! #13
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/ccd3ef0f7d741f039ba45d508e1b376dbd48fb7c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]THE TIME HAS COME[/b] [b]-[/b] [b]EARLY ACCESS OUT NOW![/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p]After around 5 years in the making, we’re finally ready to release BRUTAL JOHN 2 into Early Access.[/p][p]This Early Access release packs around [b]4 to 7 hours of brutal action and crazy fun,[/b] [b]you’re getting about 70% of the full game[/b] right out of the gate.[/p][p]You’ll be thrown into a wild ride full of chaos: crypto-mining madness, hostile aliens, giant monsters, armed vloggers, piranha death traps, bank robberies, crocodile concerts (yep, that’s real), and a ton of other unhinged surprises.[/p][p]Also you’ve got explosive vehicle mayhem, a wild west motorcycle ride, and a bunch of insane cutscenes to keep the chaos flowing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/5f18fc2541bbd6b22622b0762977a7dad8318843.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if you’re a fan of classic shooters — keep your eyes peeled. The game’s packed with Easter Eggs and nods to old-school FPS legends.[/p][p]It’s ridiculous — in the absolute best way.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]ROADMAP UPDATED AND WHAT'S COMING NEXT:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/5a27dd080619c9ca8291cec7e54926e4f016d6b8.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Early Access — What’s Next?[/b][/h2][p]Together with you, we've walked a long and challenging road of development. Every day we read your feedback and tried, within our means, to implement your coolest ideas.[/p][p]In future updates, we aim to keep the fun going and are also looking into adding more content, more story missions, more easter eggs, more brutal fun.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Current schedule for updates:[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="142,"][tr][th colwidth="142"][p]Updates[/p][/th][th][p]Update Release Dates and Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="142"][p]Content Update #1[/p][/td][td][p]Q3 2025. Adding ~2 story missions.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="142"][p]Content Update #2[/p][/td][td][p]Q4 2025. Adding ~3 story missions.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="142"][p]Full Release Update[/p][/td][td][p]Q4 2025 (Around December). Adding final story missions. Campaign wrapping up.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Between major Content Updates, we’ll also regularly release patches and bug fixes[b].[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Enjoy the game! And don't forget to spread the word. Thank you![/b][/p]

notes.title: New Trailer Released, Release Date, Roadmap #10
notes.notes:
Hello dear fans!

The day has come - here is Re-Announce Trailer with Release Date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/1ab0876974386d38d2d86f0e681422cd4e69fbca.jpg[/img]
https://youtu.be/aT3J5SbwzGI

The game was re-announced as BRUTAL JOHN 2. Releasing 22 July in Early Access. Early Access at launch will have 12 fully polished levels, a lot of content, and it's around 7 hours of gameplay.

And don't worry guys - you will receive what was promised in BRUTAL JOHN 1 + many new, amazing improvements.

Additionally, new high-quality key art and new screenshots were released, and demo was updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/d18c739613ddd1d6aad3c60379074d127a5b70c3.jpg[/img]
Reasoning behind game Re-Announce:

The game has evolved and moved so far from its original concept over 5 years of development that it could now be called Totally Updated Brutal John, or simply Brutal John 2. No more lame John you remembered from 2022.

At the start of development, Brutal John was a joke project that parodied modern old-school-style games. However, you, dear players, saw potential in the project and wanted it to become a true, serious FPS game.

Your support and attention have been our only motivation to keep working, as we have been developing this project without any funding.

Over the past three years, we have carefully read every one of your reviews and feedback, and over the last year, we also actively conducted playtests to make the project even better. What awaits you in the upcoming release will definitely make you happy.

Among other things, the "2" in the title also symbolizes the new second main character in the game — Brutal Dog — who you fell in love with from the very first footage. You'll be able to play as him in many of the game's levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/5f18fc2541bbd6b22622b0762977a7dad8318843.jpg[/img]

Development News:

Let us remind you that during the second half of last year, we focused on enriching the game with interesting moments and cutting down on boring parts, such as long corridors or excessive searches for levers and keycards. As a result, almost half of the levels were completely rebuilt from scratch.

The game is now packed with much more engaging content, and we are confident that your desire to play it through to the end will be stronger than ever.

At the time of writing this news update, we are actively working on adding Easter Eggs, positive references to legendary games from the '90s and 2000s, revising dialogues and preparing them for voiceovers, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/50a3aa8ebe143d1c444c359a984f886ae874540d.jpg[/img]
Development Roadmap:

The next stage is participating in the Steam Next Fest: June Edition, along with a Demo Update featuring a brand-new level.

After that, the Early Access release is scheduled for July 22.

The Full Release is currently planned for December 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/54094c698384a4c7336c89eb6f3e27394e0d727a.jpg[/img]



FAQ:

Question 1: Where is BRUTAL JOHN 1? Will there be a BRUTAL JOHN 1? Why was the game renamed to BRUTAL JOHN 2?
Answer: BRUTAL JOHN 1 is now BRUTAL JOHN 2. The detailed reasons were explained above.

Question 2: Why Early Access? Why not a Full Release?
Answer: Because we want to release a polished product and incorporate feedbacks from the community. You all know well the examples of boomer shooters that launched directly as a full release — it didn't end well.

Question 3: Why has the release been postponed again?! You said in March that the game would be released in two months!
Answer: This delay has nothing to do with the development of the game. Development is going smoothly, no problems. This time we postponed the release solely to participate in the Steam Next Fest: June Edition (since we can only do it once) and to choose a better release window to avoid clashing with other major game releases.


Thanks for your support! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Holo Girls, Bunny Hop Update #4
notes.notes:
Hello dear fans of reptiloid battles! Today we are pleased to present you with a fresh update to the BRUTAL JOHN demo!

In this update, we spent a whole month paying attention to your feedback, most of the suggestions were very hard to implement, but we hope it was worth it!

1. We paid a lot of attention to the crosshair, we made it highly customizable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/9d7bdfbcb4ee55991ef5203b49fadca2dd3a5062.png[/img]

2. The most important change is that we have completely overhauled the player movement system. We were constantly getting reports of issues with steering, heavy platforming and jolting while walking and have devoted the most time to addressing this issue in this update.

In addition to a completely revamped player movement system - we've added the ability to do sliding and bunnyhops, we've made these two mechanics complementary (a slide will allow you to maintain speed) so that you get the most out of your movement. In the future, we will pay even more attention to the movement system.

3. And among other things - we put neon strippers that will dance for you on the rooftops of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/ae9f7ee3ac251907727243b77e88410c3c07301d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/cc28c45e59d88a882b509224dcbe28c95210b439.png[/img]

Enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Development News and Progress #1
notes.notes:
Greetings, community!

[b]DEVELOPMENT NEWS:[/b]
We can say with confidence that most of the heavy lifting has been done. We are pleased to report that we are almost finished with majority of the game's levels. At this point, it's mainly about the icing on the cake, making sure everything is running smoothly and creating the best possible experience for our players. The end is near and we can't wait to share our love and passion for this project with you soon.

[b]NEW DEMO UPDATE:[/b]
After some hard work and dedication, we are pleased to announce that we have implemented several improvements throughout the game. These include improved controls, improvement of pistol shooting and fists, a new reworked minigun model, and an optional marking system to help players navigate more easily. The changes to the demo version may seem minor because we're doing a lot of work on the entire game, not just the demo. And these adjustments will offer a more pleasant and accessible experience for players of all skill levels.

[b]RELEASE DATE NEWS:[/b]
Due to the difficulties that we've encountered in the development process, we have decided to push back the release date to 2024. While this may be disappointing, we assure you that we are working tirelessly to ensure that the final product lives up to your expectations.

Although we are a team of passionate developers working on this project in our free time without budgets, we strive to create an immersive and enjoyable experience for our players, and we want to make sure that it is properly polished before we share it with you.

Thank you for waiting, and enjoy updated demo!
